# Sillage

> A browser-based 3D Gaussian splat engine that draws every splat as a brush mark. It has a JavaScript API for pages and for Node, a command line, and an MCP server. Scenes are built-in ids or plain JSON documents.

Start with AGENTS.md: it covers every command, the scene document format, the render options and the API in one file. `node cli/sillage.mjs guide` prints it, `node cli/sillage.mjs tools` prints the tool definitions as JSON, and `node cli/sillage.mjs schema` prints the scene format as JSON Schema.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): command line, MCP, scene documents, render options, JavaScript API, error codes, limits.
- [Prompting Sillage](docs/prompting.md): what the engine is for, the working method for a model, and example prompts with results; scene documents in docs/examples/.
- [Rendering method](docs/gaussian-brush-method.md): how splats become brush marks.
- [Physics](docs/splat-physics.md): the splat physics lab.
- [README](README.md): the studios and scenes, in prose.

## Code

- [Page API](src/sillage/index.js): `createSillage(canvas, {scene})`.
- [Scene documents](src/sillage/scene.js): validate, inspect, compile, schema, templates.
- [Render options](src/sillage/styles.js): every option with type, range, default.
- [States](src/sillage/machine.js): the life cycles of an instance, the viewer page and a headless session, as tables.
- [Node API](cli/index.mjs): `openSession()`, `runTool()`, and the pure modules.
- [Command line](cli/sillage.mjs) and [tools](cli/lib/tools.mjs).
